ValidationRule.description: If the field should be populated in value except Space available upgrade and Firm space upgrade instead due to recovery type
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND($Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Quantity_field_entered_incorrectlyQCC__c=TRUE, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Credit Card Refund'), NOT( ISBLANK( Amount__c ) ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'EFT Refund'), NOT( ISBLANK( Amount__c ) ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Flowers'), NOT( ISBLANK( Amount__c ) ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Dinner vouchers'), NOT( ISBLANK( Amount__c ) ) ),
AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Travel vouchers'), NOT( ISBLANK( Amount__c ) ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Wine') , NOT( ISBLANK( Amount__c ) ) )))
